::: {#exm-SE-sample-mean}
#### Standard error of the sample mean

In @exm-mse-sample-mean,
$\Var{\bar X} = \varpar / n$,
so

$$
\begin{aligned}
  \SE{\bar X} &= \sqrt{\sdpar^2 / n} \\
  &= \sdpar / \sqrt{n}.
\end{aligned}
$$

With $n = 50$ students,
the standard error of the sample mean height
is $\sdpar / \sqrt{50} \approx 0.14\sdpar$.
:::
